evals.prompt: Use this Innovation Studio filtered projects URL to refresh my existing hackathon-submissions.md in place. Device compliance requires sign-in through an external Edge window. Keep one local image per project and remove stale generated images.
evals.expected_output: The assistant asks for missing paths, launches external Edge, waits for sign-in, runs the bundled extractor, and reports verified project and image counts.
expectations: Uses the bundled external Edge launcher rather than an embedded browser
Uses the bundled extractor with the provided listing URL and output path
Verifies project count, unique links, local images, and Markdown fence balance
Synchronizes only stale images recorded in the generated manifest

evals.prompt: My Innovation Studio catalog run stopped halfway through after Edge timed out. Continue the same export without starting over or producing a partial Markdown file.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reuses the same URL, output, images, state, and CDP endpoint so the extractor resumes its incomplete checkpoint and verifies the final catalog.
expectations: Preserves and reuses the incomplete state file
Does not delete the checkpoint or silently accept partial results
Runs final verification before reporting success

evals.prompt: The generated Innovation Studio Markdown preview is blank and several image.png placeholders are broken. Repair it and make future refreshes safe.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reruns the bundled extractor, which removes authenticated inline content-image references, balances code fences, retains at most one verified local image per project, and validates the result.
expectations: Balances malformed fenced code blocks at imported field boundaries
Retains at most one generated local image per project
Checks that no linked local image is missing
